_source: Shape of a Twilio Programmable Messaging inbound webhook (application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST, shown as its parameters) as documented in Twilio's Messaging webhook and Message resource reference (researched 2026-10-03); hand-written, not captured from a real account. Numbers are the fictional +1555555010x series; the account SID is Twilio's documented ACXXX… placeholder and the message SIDs are made up.
_description: HELP. Twilio may answer it with the console's HELP auto-reply; if forwarded, the engine sees it as text.
